subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should visible `message(action=send)` sends resolve `messages.responsePrefix` provider/model/thinking templates from the current agent attempt, or should those attribution tokens remain unsupported on tool sends?
rationale: Current main has a deliberate static/identity-only implementation, while the discussion asks for provider/model/thinking parity and the correct source of selected-attempt context is a product/runtime contract choice.

options.title: Add model-aware tool-send prefixes
options.body: Carry current-attempt provider/model/thinking context into visible message-tool sends and resolve the existing prefix template without leaking unresolved placeholders.

options.title: Keep static and identity only
options.body: Document that message-tool sends support literal and identity prefixes but skip selected-model templates because tool sends do not own live model selection.

options.title: Move attribution to a separate feature
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to prefix consistency and track model attribution through the broader message-attribution work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/33975.

recommendation.title: Add model-aware tool-send prefixes
recommendation.body: Carry current-attempt provider/model/thinking context into visible message-tool sends and resolve the existing prefix template without leaking unresolved placeholders.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-line blame and recent broad carrying work make this the best available routing candidate for the runtime-contract decision, though the ownership trail is shared with the merged partial-fix author.
